summary: Iteration 2 verified the new SETTINGS tab (8th tab) and the switch to REAL integrations. Backend: 12/12 pytest passed against the public preview URL. /api/settings returns ha_url/ollama_url/pi_ip/hostname/ha_token_set/ha_token_masked with the raw ha_token correctly omitted; the seeded token is masked as 'eyJhbG…tZ8E'. POST /api/settings with {ollama_url} updates without touching the token; POST with {ha_token} replaces it and the masked value changes accordingly. /api/settings/test returns 200 with {ha,ollama,docker} keys (all ok=false in this preview as expected). /api/docker returns [] (no 5xx) when /var/run/docker.sock is missing. /api/homeassistant/devices returns 200 with online:false+error when HA unreachable, and 400 when the token is cleared. /api/network/scan returns central_id='pi' with the pi node in devices. /api/system returns real psutil-derived numbers (cpu>=0, ram_used>0, ram_total>0, timestamp present, uptime int). /api/ollama/models still lists claude-sonnet-4.5/gpt-5.4/gemini-3.1-pro even when Ollama is down. /api/ollama/chat returns a real Claude Sonnet 4.5 reply via emergentintegrations. Settings persistence verified (POST hostname → GET reflects). Frontend (mobile 390x844 via Playwright): Boot screen → ENTER NEXUS → /dashboard, all 8 tab testIDs present (tab-dashboard…tab-settings). Tapping tab-settings renders settings-screen with HOST/HOME ASSISTANT/OLLAMA sections; cfg-hostname='RASPBERRY-TENSHI', cfg-pi-ip='192.168.12.177', cfg-ha-url='http://192.168.12.177:8123', cfg-ollama-url='http://localhost:11434'. HA token row shows the masked token + a green SET dot and a REPLACE TOKEN button. Tapping cfg-replace-token reveals cfg-ha-token + cfg-ha-token-show (eye toggle works). Editing cfg-ollama-url and tapping cfg-save displays the [ ALERT ] CONFIG SAVED toast (testID toast); cfg-reload re-fetches and the new value persists. cfg-probe renders the three rows HOME ASSISTANT / OLLAMA / DOCKER SOCKET with red dots and the expected unreachable messages ('HTTP FAIL', '[Errno -2] Name or service not k…', 'Docker daemon unreachable: Error'). Navigating to every other tab (DASH/DOCKER/HOME/AI/NET/AUDIO/TERM) after the SETTINGS work shows no red-screen / runtime errors. No new functional issues. RN-web cosmetic warnings from iteration 1 (textShadow*, shadow*, pointerEvents prop, transform-origin DOM key) still appear and are tracked as cosmetic action items.

react_native_issues.issue: Console still shows 'textShadow*' / 'shadow*' deprecation warnings on web. Reference: /app/frontend/src/theme.ts and any Tac components using textShadowColor/textShadowRadius/shadowColor/shadowOpacity. Cosmetic only.
'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' warning persists. Audit components passing pointerEvents as a prop (likely an overlay/scanline component).

Console error 'Invalid DOM property transform-origin. Did you mean transformOrigin?' on the boot screen. Use camelCase transformOrigin in the affected animated style. Reference: boot/intro screen styling.

action_items: (Cosmetic) Migrate textShadow*/shadow* style props to the consolidated textShadow/boxShadow keys to silence RN Web warnings.
(Cosmetic) Move pointerEvents from a prop to a style on the offending overlay components.
(Cosmetic) Rename transform-origin → transformOrigin in animated style objects on the boot/intro screen.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py correctly degrades when Docker / HA / Ollama are unreachable: /api/docker returns [] (no 5xx), /api/homeassistant/devices returns 200 with online:false+error, and /api/settings/test returns 200 with per-target {ok:false,error}.

Settings store correctly masks the long-lived token in /api/settings responses (ha_token never returned; ha_token_set + ha_token_masked exposed). Mongo singleton doc '_id: singleton' is used and _id is projected out in get_settings.

Frontend settings.tsx uses storage cache for instant load, then refreshes from /api/settings; tokenDirty flag correctly omits ha_token from the save body when the user has not touched it, preserving the existing token.
psutil-backed /api/system returns real numbers in this container (ram_used>0, ram_total>0). Good fallback to zeros if psutil import fails.
All new interactive elements expose testIDs (cfg-*) — test coverage is excellent.
seed_data_creation: During testing I temporarily cleared and replaced the HA token via /api/settings. The original seeded long-lived token (from backend/.env HA_TOKEN) was restored at the end of the run; final GET /api/settings → ha_token_set=true, masked='eyJhbG…tZ8E'. ollama_url also restored to http://localhost:11434, hostname restored to RASPBERRY-TENSHI.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration-2 backend suite lives at /app/backend/tests/test_iteration2_settings.py; iteration-1 suite (test_nexus_api.py) still passes. Both use EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL from frontend/.env. HA / Docker / Ollama are intentionally unreachable in this preview — endpoints must return 200 with degraded payloads, NOT 5xx. The settings collection is a Mongo singleton {_id:'singleton'}; if any future test mutates ha_token, restore it from backend/.env HA_TOKEN via POST /api/settings before exiting.
